expertiseSources.summary: Defines applicable STRIDE, authorization, injection, data-flow, secret-exposure, and resource-exhaustion checks.

exception.rationale: This threat-review workflow traces untrusted entry points to privileged sinks, preserves credential and live-system boundaries, and distinguishes confirmed exploits from speculation and unassessed scope. The streamlining retains those protections without authorizing remediation or probing. Security risk reduction warrants the requested safety exception; no assurance of unreviewed code, comparative uplift, or human approval is claimed.
